create_clipped_distribution: create a Clipped distribution wrapping any Distrax distribution with minimum and maximum bounds
sample_clipped_normal: sample from a ClippedNormal distribution with given loc, scale, minimum, and maximum parameters
sample_clipped_logistic: sample from a ClippedLogistic distribution with given loc, scale, minimum, and maximum parameters
compute_clipped_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Clipped distribution returning -inf outside bounds
index_clipped_distribution: index into a Clipped distribution batch using __getitem__ to slice by batch dimensions
